Theme

Latin word

cōnsilium

cōnsilium, cōnsiliī n.

noun, second declension

a council; a committee; a council, a body of advisers; a decision, a resolve; what one has decided to do; an idea of what to do, a plan; the jury as a body, a bench; plan, intention or design; a plan, a measure decided on; a purpose, an intention: what someone means to do
